mappings.factory: Document(input?, context?) and required-input PackageView.open return Promises. Already owned/admitted part/image inputs do not switch to sync. Model-only new(owner), properties, collections, helpers and conversions remain synchronous.
mappings.bytes: Own Uint8Array before the first caller-controlled suspension; copy source chunks before next advance, preserve receivers, close failed/cancelled streams. Image blob getters return owned copies.
mappings.defaults: Fixed UTC 1980-01-01T00:00:00Z, empty author/initials, intrinsic limits and local un-aborted signal. No metrics/font discovery; explicit metrics only. Timestamp copied to whole-second precision. Explicit null/malformed context values reject. Document omission/null creates original template; package open remains required-input. Comment identity argument defaults remain empty.
mappings.io: Input paths require matching binaryResolver tokens. Output paths require matching context.vfs capability/filesystem; no ambient host I/O, native document runtime or implicit network. Caller transport adapters may supply sources immediately or asynchronously; domain boundaries always return Promises.
mappings.save: Document, DocumentPartView, PackageView and style model save accept ByteSink | ArchiveSink | DocxVfsPath. Stage/write/commit/abort protocol implemented; raw stream compatibility retained. Methods are captured and accessors rejected without invocation.
mappings.overwrite: VFS save exclusively creates; existing destination conflicts instead of source ambient overwrite. Explicit force/in-place belongs to the shared publication operation with conditional ownership checks.
mappings.failures: Shared typed codes retained. Stage abort awaited on write/commit/precommit cancellation failure; failed abort preserves both errors. A successful receipt wins over late cancellation. Unrecoverable raw-stream errors retain conservative possible-partial-output reporting.
mappings.cli: Final output flags/batch publication use the shared package engine. No serialized callbacks, arbitrary member invocation or nested publication. Existing plural resources, text replace, schemas, selectors, envelopes and exit statuses are unchanged.

unit.workers: One worker; unchanged timeouts and no excluded cases. This save-only snapshot precedes the separately recorded owned-capability correction.

lint.warning: Existing type-only unused operation variable in operation-types.test.ts; no errors.

build.closure: Derived from maintained declarations; portable filesystem target emitted no native binaries.

checks.development_runs: An in-flight-tree run observed mismatched older modules/new tests and a media timeout. A subsequent stable two-worker run had a table span timeout; all 63 cases in that file passed on direct rerun. The stable one-worker save snapshot passed all cases with unchanged timeouts. Final owned-capability verification is recorded separately.
